blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Semirara Mining and Power Corp. (SMPC) again slammed the Department of Energy (DOE) for expanding the asset-surrender rule, saying it sends a discouraging signal to investors attending the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila. The Consunji-led group, which has operated the Semirara coal mine site for decades, has issued another strongly worded statement on Monday, days after the DOE conducted its pre-bid conference.
